messages.content: Hi tal, I'm a friend

hey, i'm tal

think of me as your personal talent agent, your inside man... or fox

one of these days, I might slide a role right here in chat. the kind that feels like your calling.

so... what's your full name?
Priyanshu Borole
priyanshu borole... that's a name with some weight to it. where you working these days?
Working in District by Zomato as Android developer

district by zomato... the hyperlux dining play that's trying to make bangalore feel like manhattan. solid gig. 

found you on linkedin - priyanshu borole, android @district by zomato. this you? https://in.linkedin.com/in/priyanshuborole
Yes

android at district... building the app that lets people book tables at places where a meal costs more than most people's monthly groceries. the irony is beautiful - you're coding luxury while probably eating maggi at 2am. 

what made you get into mobile dev? was it the "i want to build apps" dream or did you just fall into it?
You are not able to recognise voice message?

User's LinkedIn Profile Context:
**EXECUTIVE SUMMARY**
Priyanshu Borole is an Android Developer currently employed at Zomato. Their educational background includes studies at D. Y. Patil College of Engineering.

**ROLE-BY-ROLE**
*   Zomato ([Start date not specified]) – [Role title not specified] – [Responsibilities not listed]

*   [Institution not specified] (2018-2020)
*   [Institution not specified] (2015-2018)
*   [Institution not specified] (Ended 2015)

nah, voice messages aren't my thing right now. just text works best for me.

but back to you - dy patil college to android at zomato... that's a solid trajectory from pune to building apps that handle crores of food orders. what got you into the mobile dev game?
I just want to build app and publish to playstore and want user to use it. I love building apps

ah, the classic builder's itch. you want to see your code running on millions of phones, getting those play store downloads, reading user reviews... that's the real high.

district is probably teaching you how to handle scale - zomato's android app gets hammered during lunch rush. but i bet you're itching to ship your own thing on the side too.

how long you been working total?
I am 2024 passout have full time experience of 1.5 years and 2 years of internship experience in college fays

3.5 years total... not bad for someone who graduated this year. you've been grinding since college days. respect.

what kind of role you looking for next?
Looking in android domain only as of now

android only... staying in your lane, smart. the market's hot for mobile devs right now.

bangalore or open to remote/other cities?
Bangalore  + open to remote
3.5 years + android dev + bangalore/remote... sound right?
Count it as 1.5 years because that's what full time experience I have

got it, counting only full-time work. makes sense.

1.5 years + android dev + bangalore/remote... sound right?
done. i'm spinning things up on my end. you'll start seeing good stuff soon.
Yeah sound rights

you're in! 

android roles are about to start dropping here. the good ones - places that actually understand mobile isn't just "make the website smaller". 

time to level up from coding luxury dining apps to building something that matters. or at least pays better 😉
When will I start seeing good stuff again as you said

when my team sends something that fits your profile. could be tomorrow, could be next week.

no promises, but i'll ping you when it's worth your time.
Hi
Hi
what's up?
Doing good, you

same old same old. reviewing thousands of roles, trying to find the ones that don't suck.

what's the vibe at district these days? still building the app that lets people spend ₹10k on dinner?
Yess, it's not only for Rich I would say
It's not only about dining we have multiple verticals movie booking, events booking, shopping, play booking

fair enough. but let's be real - district's brand screams "luxury experience." the average person isn't booking ₹5k movie tickets or shopping at high-end boutiques through an app.

not judging, just observing the market positioning. it's actually smart - target the high-value customers who spend more.

what's the tech stack like? kotlin? jetpack compose?
Kotlin and XML as of now. But soon shifting to compose

xml in 2025... oof. but hey, legacy code is legacy code. at least you're moving to compose soon.

what's making you want to leave district? just growth or something specific?
Job location mostly

wait what... you're at district in bangalore but want to leave because of location? i'm confused.

are you remote right now and they want you back in office? or you're in bangalore but want something fully remote?
I am gurgaon, district is in gurgaon. I want bangalore location or remote

ohhhh right, district is zomato's luxury vertical based in gurgaon. my bad.

so you're in gurgaon now, want bangalore or remote. got it.

what's the salary situation? what are you making now and what would make you move?

hey, happy monday - if it’s not, we’ll work together on making it happen soon :)
how’s the week looking? what would you like me to focus on this week with the search?
I have 37L ctc which is 28L base and 9L performance bonus

37L ctc at 1.5 years... that's actually solid for gurgaon. zomato paying well for their luxury vertical.

so you're looking for bangalore or remote at similar or better comp. what's the minimum you'd accept? and what's your target?
Minimum I will accept as 28L base and target is 34L base

28L base minimum, 34L base target. got it.

so you're basically looking to maintain your current base or get a decent bump. makes sense.

what kind of companies are you interested in? startups? established tech? any specific industries you want to avoid?
Open to all types of companies

open to all... that's either "i'm flexible" or "i haven't thought about it yet."

what's your notice period? and when are you looking to make the move?
Notice period is 15days

15 days notice is actually great. most places are 30-60 days, so you've got flexibility.

so to summarize:
- 1.5 years android dev (kotlin/xml, moving to compose)
- currently at district by zomato in gurgaon
- want bangalore location or remote
- 37L ctc (28L base + 9L bonus)
- target: 34L+ base
- notice: 15 days
- open to all company types

anything i'm missing? any dealbreakers or must-haves?
Naah not missing anything

cool. i'll keep an eye out for android roles that match your profile.

btw what's making you want to leave district? just location or something else?
Just a location

location's a legit reason. gurgaon to bangalore is a vibe shift for sure.

i'll ping you if something good comes up. in the meantime, keep building that compose knowledge - market's hot for android devs who know modern stack.

anything else you want to chat about?
Nooe
alright. talk soon.
Sure bye
